sources.title: phi 4 — AI Model Radar
sources.snippet: Phi-4 is a 14 billion parameter text generation model designed for complex reasoning tasks with efficient operation in memory-constrained environments. The open-weights model was trained on synthetic datasets, curated web data, and academic materials, with instruction-following and safety improvements.
